parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic. It is a long, narrow component extending from the frame to the ear.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of acetate plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the wearer’s head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint connecting it to the base body, allowing folding and unfolding for storage and wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame Front)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the eyeglasses that holds the lenses, made of acetate plastic. It includes the bridge and rims.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the structural foundation for the eyeglasses, connecting both legs.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central support structure for the entire eyeglass assembly.
